title: Block Out Level 8 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 8 hides a huge red slab in the lower-right well. Work the green, white, and black mini-blocks through the top and right counters first, then use the opened corridor to finally move the red slab.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 8 hides a huge red slab in the lower-right well. Work the green, white, and black mini-blocks through the top and right counters first, then use the opened corridor to finally move the red slab.
landmarks: Block Out Level 8 hides a huge red slab in the lower-right well.
Work the green, white, and black mini-blocks through the top and right counters first, then use the opened corridor to finally move the red slab.
The board mixes Red, Green, White and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The upper corridor matters more than the giant red slab at the start.
Keep the right-side meter falling while the top cap is also shrinking.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Push the top-right white and black pair into the right-side quota lane to start shrinking the `9` meter.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Rotate the upper green mini-blocks across the top corridor so the `17` cap and the right meter keep dropping together.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Use the narrow center stem to pass the next white block downward and keep the upper-right column from refilling.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Continue trimming the black-and-green cluster until the right column is almost empty and the side meter is nearly exhausted.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Once the upper corridor opens, shift the remaining small pieces aside so the red slab has a clean vertical lane.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Slide the large red rectangle upward and across toward the red exit on the left wall.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish by feeding the last green mini-block through the top green finish after the quotas have fully cleared.

failurePoints: Trying to move the oversized red slab before the upper corridor is mostly empty.
Ignoring the right quota lane and only working the top cap.
